svg.title: STM32F411 bare-metal keypad driver
svg.desc: A logic-analyser view of one key press on a 4x4 keypad driven by a bare-metal STM32F411 driver. The scan column steps across the keypad while the switch contact chatters; the debounce state machine falls back to IDLE when a bounce drops out, then reaches PRESSED once the contact has been stable for 20 ms and Keypad_Scan returns the key exactly once, even though it stays held.
